items.name: Nidhi Mehta
items.quote: Filing used to arrive as a scramble. The monthly rhythm made GST and books feel like one conversation instead of five.

items.name: Karan Joshi
items.quote: The project note was written for the banker, not for a slide deck. Assumptions were visible and the numbers held up in the meeting.

items.name: Ayesha Khan
items.quote: Partners stayed on the call when a notice arrived. We left with a sequence of documents, not a generic reassurance.
